Class GlacialThermodynamicMeltEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.GlacialThermodynamicMeltEngine
public class GlacialThermodynamicMeltEngine extends Object
Cryospheric Thermodynamic invalid input: '&' Positive Degree-Day (PDD) Glacial Melt Engine.

Models ice sheet and glacier ablation based on exact 1st Law Thermodynamics:

  • Latent Heat of Fusion: $L_f = 333.55 \times 10^3 \text{ J/kg}$.
  • Ice Density: $\rho_{ice} = 917.0 \text{ kg/m}^3$.
  • Positive Degree-Days (PDD): $\text{PDD} = \max(0, T - T_{melt})$ integrated over time.
  • Melt Volume invalid input: '&' Mass Balance: $\Delta M_{ice} = \frac{Q_{net}}{L_f} = \frac{k_{pdd} \cdot \text{PDD} \cdot \Delta t}{L_f}$.
  • Eustatic Sea Level Coupling: $\Delta S_L = \frac{\sum \Delta M_{ice}}{\rho_{water} \cdot A_{ocean}}$.
Version:
4.3.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
